sustaining_condition: Service clears admitted work and the queue remains inside the low-load basin
exit_condition: A burst crosses the retry/congestion boundary unless intake is bounded
what_would_refute_it: Real service capacity does not depend on queue depth as assumed

regime: Bounded useful work with continuing rejection
sustaining_condition: Admission rejects excess demand while some backlog and service persist
exit_condition: Demand drops or capacity changes
what_would_refute_it: Real admission can be bypassed or control work consumes the reserved service

sustaining_condition: Retries replenish more work than the congested server clears even after new arrivals cease
exit_condition: Cut retry feedback and admit less than degraded service can drain
what_would_refute_it: Retry production is bounded independently of backlog in the real system

sustaining_condition: Fresh arrivals exactly equal congested service so growth stops but the old queue does not drain
exit_condition: Temporarily reduce all intake below actual service or restore capacity
what_would_refute_it: Measured service exceeds incoming work and the queue drains without intervention

sustaining_condition: Each failed boot adds heat faster than immediate retry lets it dissipate
exit_condition: A sufficient cooling interval or lower boot cost moves the state into the running basin
what_would_refute_it: Repeated failed starts do not accumulate the assumed resource pressure

sustaining_condition: Startup succeeds and running operation dissipates accumulated heat
exit_condition: A new fault or incompatible binary changes the dynamics
what_would_refute_it: Running work itself heats faster than the simplified model allows

sustaining_condition: Backoff cools resources but every attempt still uses the same broken binary
exit_condition: Repair or replace the cause or end retries in quarantine
what_would_refute_it: The failure is transient and another attempt succeeds without changed conditions

sustaining_condition: Finite attempt rule prevents more starts until explicit intervention
exit_condition: Authorized repair plus a new bounded attempt
what_would_refute_it: The actual supervisor restarts through an uncounted path

sustaining_condition: Assumed overload response mutes indefinitely and no expiry path exists
exit_condition: Independent review or explicit unmute changes the controller
what_would_refute_it: Operators never use indefinite suppression or another path reliably breaks it

sustaining_condition: Mute expires into unchanged overload and triggers another mute
exit_condition: Remove or group the symptom stream or increase legitimate handling capacity
what_would_refute_it: Incident arrival is transient rather than sustained as modelled

sustaining_condition: Repeated symptoms collapse into one actionable item and a human can service it
exit_condition: Human capacity disappears or distinct incidents cannot safely be merged
what_would_refute_it: Grouping hides different urgent effects or the assumed human service is absent

regime: One pending incident and nobody to act
sustaining_condition: No reachable legitimate human services the queue despite bounded grouping
exit_condition: A legitimate available recipient takes over
what_would_refute_it: The incident has a safe authorized automatic resolution already in place

sustaining_condition: Echo verification reinforces agreement while the artifact remains wrong
exit_condition: Independent contradiction changes the evidence process
what_would_refute_it: Existing checks are genuinely independent and reject the error

sustaining_condition: An independent check rejects the artifact but cannot repair it
exit_condition: A justified correction or legitimate abandonment
what_would_refute_it: The supposed independent contradiction is itself wrong or not available

regime: Corrected accepted artifact under stipulated oracle
sustaining_condition: The toy verifier has perfect knowledge and repair ability by assumption
exit_condition: Loss of that oracle invalidates the result guarantee
what_would_refute_it: Real domain judgement is uncertain or repair cannot be performed

sustaining_condition: An external schedule alternates two unfenced writers with incompatible desired values
exit_condition: Participant-enforced exclusion or legitimate cessation of one writer
what_would_refute_it: The actual writers commute or never overlap in business identity

regime: Stable business value despite alternating attempts
sustaining_condition: The participant actually rejects the excluded writer while scheduler phase still alternates
exit_condition: Loss of fencing enforcement or authorized ownership transfer
what_would_refute_it: The fence is merely a local UUID or mock promise

regime: Unconfirmed effect with no further call
sustaining_condition: Participant accepted but no response arrives and sender refuses to repeat
exit_condition: Independent receipt or legitimate explicit risk decision
what_would_refute_it: The response has a real bounded eventual-delivery guarantee

regime: Unconfirmed effect with repeated deduplicated calls
sustaining_condition: Participant memory prevents duplicate effect but retries continue without confirmation
exit_condition: Recover confirmation or end retries before resource exhaustion
what_would_refute_it: Deduplication expires or differs across business-equivalent requests

sustaining_condition: The model observer knows a second acceptance happened and that historical fact cannot be undone
exit_condition: Future harm may be contained but past duplication cannot be un-happened
what_would_refute_it: The participant atomically rejected the duplicate before effect

sustaining_condition: A delayed reply finally confirms the single operation
exit_condition: A new independent task is a new trajectory rather than continuation
what_would_refute_it: The confirmation is not durable authoritative evidence for that operation

regime: Restored historical work held before dispatch
sustaining_condition: A restore gate recognizes that old intent is not proof of no prior effect
exit_condition: Current operation and authority evidence permit an explicit next action
what_would_refute_it: Restore or a copied snapshot bypasses the gate
